notes: v0.4-gold 207 KEEP plus the final increment: 19 logs and 14 profile updates complete the 240-item exam (ADR 0009). The log family was 79 percent fuzzy_portion because its other four situations each existed as one hardcoded instance; multi_item_log, unit_convert, near_synonym and ledger_gap are table-backed now and the family finishes balanced. The update rows cover axes the family had never exercised: removing an allergy, moving one bound rather than both, two windows in one request, several allergens at once, and a plan_preset change -- each declared by its row and cross-checked against the spoken query in both directions. Reviewed by validate_draft plus an LLM reviewer; not reviewed item-by-item by a human.
